data.reasoning: The only valid report (deepseek-v4-flash) correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard, safe Go build script with pinned checksums and no malicious code execution. The other report (qwen3-235b) resulted in an inconclusive verdict due to an LLM API failure (HTTP 400), which carries no verdict signal and is treated as missing.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely an artifact of a tool error. The qwen model failed to complete the audit due to an HTTP 400 BadRequestError, resulting in an inconclusive verdict, while the deepseek model successfully audited the files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed with an LLM API error (HTTP 400) during the final file review, resulting in no verdict for .SRCINFO and PKGBUILD.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400/500) to prevent a single failed request from invalidating the entire audit.
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security ambiguity' and 'inconclusive due to tool/API failure' in the final verdict reporting to avoid triggering unnecessary escalation audits.
